title: festuca rubra f. prolifera
intro: Festuca rubra f. prolifera, commonly known as red fescue, is a type of perennial grass known for its spreading habit and ability to form dense clumps. Red fescue is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as wounds and skin infections. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antifungal activity, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of red fescue include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
